Title: 🔥 Why Your Facebook Ads Aren’t Scaling – Fix These Manual Bidding Mistakes NOW 👇
Full_Description:
🔥 Why Your Facebook Ads Aren’t Scaling – Fix These Manual Bidding Mistakes NOW 👇

❌ Small Budgets Don’t Work with Manual Bidding

Manual bidding with low budgets is like bringing a knife to a gunfight. Facebook won’t even enter auctions if your bid isn’t competitive. 

If your CPA goal is $30 and you’re spending $50/day, you’re invisible. Manual bidding thrives with scale, not hesitation.

Start with 5-10x your CPA. If your goal is $40, your daily budget should be $200-$400. This gives Facebook room to optimize aggressively.

❌ You’re Treating Manual Bidding Like a Shortcut

Here’s the truth – manual bidding won’t fix bad campaigns. If your ads aren’t converting with lowest-cost bidding, manual won’t magically save them. 

You’re just spending more to lose faster. Manual bidding works when your pixel has at least 200 purchases in the last 30 days. 

Anything less and you’re burning cash. Focus on creative testing and audience refinement before even thinking about manual bids. Nail your winning ads first. 

❌ You’re Playing It Too Safe with Bids

Most advertisers bid at their CPA target – and that’s why they lose. Facebook prioritizes higher bids. If you’re wondering why your ads aren’t delivering, it’s because someone else is outbidding you.

Bid 20-30% above your CPA goal. A $50 CPA? Start bidding at $65. Facebook won’t overspend if the conversion isn’t there – but you’ll dominate auctions when it counts.

💡 Use cost caps to control risk and maintain profitability. Let Facebook handle the scaling – your job is to give it strong data and budget firepower. Manual bidding isn’t the problem. The wrong timing and setup is.

Title: How to Structure Campaigns for $50,000+/Day Profits 🚀
Full_Description:
How to Structure Campaigns for $50,000+/Day Profits 🚀

Want to scale your campaigns to $50K+ per day in profit, just like we did for one of our clients who spent $19,118 and made back $66,168 in a single day? 

Here’s the exact structure we used to make it happen:

💡 Start with a Strong Foundation: Campaign Structure:

Top-of-Funnel (TOF): Target new, high-intent audiences (Lookalikes, broad interests) **ABO with atleast $10Per Adset Min.**

Middle-of-Funnel (MOF): Retarget warm audiences (Add-to-Cart, 50%+ video viewers). 

Bottom-of-Funnel (BOF): Engage your most high-intent audience (past purchasers, 75%+ video watchers).

💡 Utilize Advantage+ Campaigns (ASC)

Start at $100/day for testing, then gradually scale by 20%-30% every 3-5 days as performance stabilizes. Be patient—this takes time, but the rewards are worth it.

💡 Aggressively Scaling with Manual Bidding 

Once your pixel has gathered enough purchase data (300-400 conversions), Facebook’s algorithm has a solid understanding of your audience. 

Go to Manual Bidding and set your bid cap slightly higher than your average Cost Per Purchase (CPP). 

Let's say, If your average CPP is $25, set your bid cap at $30-$35 to ensure you're competitive in the auction without overspending.
